pr_title: Clear field caps index responses on cancellation
pr_comment: Hi @dnhatn, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Hi @dnhatn, I've updated the changelog YAML for you.
@DaveCTurner Thanks for your review. It's ready again.

review_comment:
Hmm AIUI this might notify the caller immediately on cancellation, even though there are some outstanding remote actions. I think we should wait for pending remote actions to complete before responding, although of course it is important to react (internally) to the cancellation right away like this.

In other words, we should acquire a ref when _sending_ each remote request, rather than trying to acquire one when we receive the response.
Thanks David. I've updated the PR to clear the resources on cancelled, stop accumulating errors/responses after cancelled, and wait for remote actions before replying to the caller.

I think this is still slightly racy - we should check for cancellation _after_ collecting the response to see if the newly-added response should now be dropped.

(it's ok to check first too ofc)
